    Get ready

    What to have on hand

    Use a work permit, passport, driver's license or civil registry record. Bring the original to your appointment; documents with an expiry date must be current.

    For vaccines, you can upload JPG or PNG photos and PDF documents. Include all pages with your name, the vaccine name and the dose dates.

    Photograph the full page with good light and no glare. Up to 5 files, 8 MB per file and 12 pages per PDF.

    Help

    We are here to guide you

    Complete the registration exactly as it appears on your identification document. Fields marked with * are required.

    You can review previous steps before submitting. Data is saved when you submit the registration, not when you change steps. Afterwards you can request a private link to edit it.

    If you don't have your vaccination record or a file doesn't read well, continue with the registration and bring your original documents to the appointment.

    For medical questions or help with an expired link, contact the clinic that shared this portal with you.

    Staff area

    Clinic access

    Only authorized staff of Alivio Medical Center can view patient records and documents.

    Privacy

    Privacy and data use

    Alivio Medical Center uses personal, immigration and health data to prepare your Form I-693 and review your vaccination record. Do not send information about other people except that of the responsible adult when necessary.

    Documents are processed with the reading engine configured by the clinic, which may run in your browser or in a secure clinic service. When you submit the registration, data and files are stored encrypted and authorized staff access is logged. No drafts are saved on this device.

    Editing links are private and expire after 7 days. Anyone with the link can edit your registration during that period; do not share it or use public devices.

    To correct data, request deletion or learn about retention periods, contact the clinic that shared this portal with you. Using this site does not by itself prove regulatory compliance.

    Delete patient

    Delete patient

    This permanently deletes the patient profile and all their data from this portal. This action cannot be undone.
